decision: Do not use observed-covariate importance weighting as a P3 promotion gate and do not continue the same Hs2 or ERA5 residual family.
executed_experiment: Atmosphere-complete champion-residual predictability pilot using past-only 12h and 18/24h observed-wind lag features with small regularized direct residual models.
fixed_stop_rule: Strict outer-fold case-bootstrap CI90 upper was not below zero; no candidate CSV was created and the direction is closed.
next_resource_allocation: Prioritize deep-research-grounded P1 and P2 structural experiments. Reopen P3 only with information independent of the current past-summary feature family.
